gather_information.name: Gather Information
gather_information.synergyNotes: 5+ ranks in Knowledge (local) gives +2 on Gather Information checks.

actions.name: Canvass Local Rumors and Gossip
actions.description: Spend several hours and a few coins in tavern taprooms to uncover common news and local gossip.

actions.name: Investigate Specific Secret Rumor
actions.description: Probe discreetly into sensitive or guarded topics without tipping off local authorities or syndicates.
